task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an life changing round of TextWorld? You do! Here is how to play! First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to make an effort to go west. That done, move west. Okay, and then, make an attempt to venture south. Then, try to venture east. And then, pick up the cucumber from the floor of the study. And if you do that, you're the winner!
description:
You've entered an office. You decide to just list off a complete list of everything you see in the room, because hey, why not?



You don't like doors? Why not try going east, that entranceway is unblocked. You don't like doors? Why not try going south, that entranceway is unguarded. There is an unguarded exit to the west.

summary: I am in the office.
thought: I should go west as the first step.
feedback:
Well how about that, you are in the place we're calling the bar.

You can see a trunk. There's something strange about this thing being here, but you don't have time to worry about that now. You can see a locker. Suddenly, you bump your head on the ceiling, but it's not such a bad bump that it's going to prevent you from looking at objects and even things. The locker is empty! This is the worst thing that could possibly happen, ever!

There is an exit to the east. Don't worry, it is unguarded. There is an unguarded exit to the south. There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, it is unguarded.
